svg.aria-label: The round island to scale: nine lands round Hearthmoot
svg.text: The round island to scale: 10.7 km across, nine lands round Hearthmoot
White dots: the three wake-up camps per land. Lines: each land's road from its middle camp to its gate.
Squares: gate forts at the guarded Commons. Red triangles: major boss lairs, off the roads, deep inland.
Dashed rings: coast (easy), midlands, inland (hard). Yellow diamonds: Wind, Spore and Arcane starts.
White dashes: sky islands overhead. Purple and green dots: Crystal caves and Fungal caverns below.
Pale ring: calm shallows (300 m); wider ring: reefs (1.2 km); then deep sea.
